'''Ikasuri Shrine''' (坐摩神社, ''Ikasuri jinja'', also known as ''Zama jinja'') is a major [[Shinto]] shrine located in central {{ill|Osaka|en|Osaka|qid=Q35765|lt=Osaka}}, Japan. Its annual festival is on April 22. In the former [[modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines]] it was an imperial shrine of the second Rank or ''[[Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|Kanpei-chūsha]]'' (官幣中社). It was also the [[ichinomiya]] of the former {{ill|Settsu Province|ca|Província de Settsu|cs|Provincie Seccu|de|Provinz Settsu|eo|Provinco Seccu|es|Provincia de Settsu|fa|ولایت ستسو|fr|Province de Settsu|gl|Provincia de Settsu|hak|Settsu-koet|id|Provinsi Settsu|it|Settsu (provincia)|ja|摂津国|ko|셋쓰국|lt|Seccu žemė|nl|Settsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Settsu|ru|Сэтцу (провинция)|simple|Settsu Province|sk|Seccu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Сецу|tr|Settsu (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сеццу|zh|攝津國|zh_min_nan|Settu-kok|zh_yue|攝津國|qid=Q864163|lt=Settsu Province}}.
It enshrines five [[kami]] known as ''ikasuri no kami'' or ''zama no kami'': Ikui no kami (生井神), Sakui no kami (福井神), Tsunagai no kami (綱長井神), Hahiki no kami (波比祇神), and Asuha no kami (阿須波神); collectively known as {{nihongo|Ikasuri no Kami|座摩神|1=Ikasuri no Kami|2=ja|3=座摩神|4=zh|5=坐摩巫祭神|1=Ikasuri no Kami}}

== History ==
It was founded by {{ill|Empress Jingū|en|Empress Jingū|qid=Q232803|lt=Empress Jingū}} when she returned from the Three Han (三韓, Korea) campaign.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Shinto shrines {{!}} Japan {{!}} Rods Shinto |url=https://www.rodsshinto.com/ |access-date=2023-04-04 |website=shintoshrines |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Watatsumi Shrine {{!}} 海神社 {{!}}Hyōgo-ken, Kobe-shi |url=https://www.rodsshinto.com/28-108-01 |access-date=2023-04-06 |website=shintoshrines |language=en}}</ref>

She was nearly shipwrecked but managed to survive thanks to praying to {{ill|Watatsumi|en|Watatsumi|qid=Q1474187|lt=Watatsumi}}, and she made the shrine to honor him.<ref name=":1" />  [[Ikuta Shrine]] and [[Watatsumi Shrine (Kobe)|Watatsumi Shrine]] were both also made at the same time by the Empress.<ref name=":1" />
